name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added GitHub-managed WordPress updates and automatic plugin updates.
  • Hardened checkout for SanMar, S&S Activewear, Momentec, and multi-supplier WooCommerce variations.
  • Reloads variation attributes server-side before cart submission.
  • Validates stock and variation status with item-specific errors.
  • Rolls back newly added ASBO cart lines if any selected variation fails.
  • Supports validated ASBO pricing when a synced variation temporarily has a blank Woo base price.
